findings.finding: The publisher reads with Path.read_bytes and lists with is_dir/iterdir, and all of these follow symlinks. On a copy in WORK, replacing programs/EFFECT_GATE.x86_64.bpf with a symlink to identical bytes outside the directory still passed (rc 0). The publisher also closes only programs/, not the rest of architecture/compiled-filter-programs-v2/. The committed state is correct: git ls-tree shows both programs as regular 100644 blobs. Every other tamper attempt was refused: a changed byte in any of the 4 pinned v4 sources, the predecessor index or a predecessor program; an extra file, dotfile or subdirectory in programs/; a missing program or programs/ directory; an appended instruction; a changed index (whitespace, key order or a missing file); and an extra argument.
